response.text: {"verdict": "covered", "clause_ids": ["A9.1", "A9.3"], "rationale": "The claim is covered under clause A9.1, which provides coverage for cancellation fees due to an injury (podvrtnutie členkového kĺbu) that occurred before the trip.
